title: Mario keeps the beings out of his debrief to keep his PRP clearance

tellings.quote: Had I said that I saw these beings,

plain: In 1977, at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, an Air Force airman named Mario Woods says he left out of his official debriefing that he had seen non-human beings. He tells Michels that had he said he saw these beings, he would have lost his clearance under the Personnel Reliability Program, the screening that decides who is fit to work around nuclear weapons. If true, it suggests that the rules themselves pushed service members to keep such sightings off the record.
